items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Lil Hardin, Lil Armstrong's first player. ... Lil Hardin, Louis Armstrong's first ride.

ctx.x: things that they played at that time? I do not know, but I did that. My piano player came to

Chicago with him, Lil. Lil was his name? Lil Hardin, Lil Armstrong's first player. Uh-huh. Lil Hardin, Louis Armstrong's first ride. Mr. Dewey, we'd like to know the various combinations of instruments that played, uh, for the various, uh, occasions that you people were hired in New Orleans. Would you tell us how many there were and generally what instruments played? Seven. Seven pieces.
All right. Trombone, trumpet, clarinet, piano, drum, and bass. Cut it off just for the minute.
